changes: Fixed: Fire alarm and EL certificates can now be deleted.
Fixed: Deleting any certificate no longer says 'Recycle Bin' to non-admin staff — just asks 'are you sure'.
Improved: Admin now sees a choice — move to Recycle Bin or permanently delete — for all certificate types.
Improved: Recycle Bin now shows all certificate types including Fire Alarm, who deleted each one, and a Delete All button.
